description: Unofficial Gnorbu fan-art animated companion inspired by Neopets. This pink llama-like quadruped shakes a red mane, noses a soft fence upright, recovers a paper leaf, steps through a low toy ring and grooms its mane. Original animation uses articulated right, left and forward runs and a low hop. The six main mane masses and plain opposite flank are disclosed drawing simplifications; three red spots stay on one fixed reference-facing side.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
